podcast.body: A song from the "Deja Vu" album, it was climbing the top 10 charts as a single when "Ohio" was released, effectively at its expense. "At the expense of the single Woodstock, which was climbing up the top 10, the band released the single Ohio, which made it to number 14 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1970."

Ep. 43 - Music and The Kent State Massacre of May 4, 1970

podcast.body: This single was in heavy radio rotation and nearing the top 10 charts during the week of the Kent State protests and subsequent shooting in May 1970. Its chart performance was significant at the time, showcasing the band's popularity. "Their single Woodstock was already in heavy radio rotation and was lurking around the top 10, the week of the protests and the shooting."
